precondition:
Before publishing, run two tests from a specialist account that is already linked to @kasb_egalari_bot.
(1) Send a small video with a caption. The bot should reply '🎬 Video qabul qilindi.' with «✅ Post qilish» and «📖 Story qilish». After the tap, '✅ Post joylandi!' should appear, and «Postni ochish» should open the post on the profile.
(2) Send one 15-19 MB video with a caption. Confirm that '✅ Post joylandi!' arrives and that exactly one post appears on the profile.
Why test 2 matters: the webhook route (src/app/api/telegram/webhook/route.ts) exports no maxDuration and does not dedupe updates. «Post qilish» does all of this inside one request: getFile, a download with a timeout of up to 60 s for files over 6 MB (src/lib/telegram.ts:223), the storage write, and createProfilePost. A timeout leaves only the 'Joylanmoqda…' toast. A Telegram redelivery could create the post twice. If test 2 fails, do not publish until the caption's 20 MB line is lowered or maxDuration is added to the webhook route.
Delete the test posts afterwards.
Storage (R2, Blob or disk) must be configured. Otherwise the bot answers 'Saqlash xizmati sozlanmagan' (media.ts:166-167), and the post must not go out.
Also confirm that the «Telegram» tab shows in Kabinet → Profil on prod. It renders only when the bot token and username are set (src/app/kabinet/profil/page.tsx:88, 132).
Buttons: Row 1 only [📝 Ro'yxatdan o'tish → https://t.me/kasb_egalari_bot?start=reg]. button2Label and button2Url stay empty on purpose, because this is a bot-only post.
What Row 1 does for each reader:
- An already linked user gets 'Siz allaqachon ... ulangansiz ✅' and the menu (register.ts:55-62).
- A user with no account registers in the bot and must pick «🎨 Mutaxassis» to be able to post (media.ts:79-82).
- A user whose site account (email or Google) is not linked must use «Telegramga ulash» in Kabinet instead. For them, start=reg goes straight to «Siz kimsiz?» and would open a second, empty tg<chatId>@telegram.local account (register.ts:53-76; telegram-login.ts:147-164, 180-192). The caption tells this reader to link first.

- Show only the screenUi strings, and leave out every bot line that contains a dash.
- The bot reply bubble reads, in order: '🎬 Video qabul qilindi.', then 'Montaj: tayyor video' in italics, then 'Qayerga joylaymiz?' in bold.
- The header subtitle is 'bot', never a user count.
- Draw no inline buttons under the edited '✅ Post joylandi!' message.
- On the monitor, hide the tab counts and every tile counter (likes, views, comments). Use a neutral video frame as the tile thumbnail, because a video post made through the bot has no poster (media.ts:168).
- Show no follower, view or rating counts anywhere.
